title: F17: a routing workflow, with an agent for the exceptions

cards.title: Classify
cards.text: One cheap request: expected, fixable, escalate or unclear, with the rule it matched.

cards.title: The known paths in code
cards.text: Acknowledge, escalate, or fix then confirm, the same way every time.

cards.title: The agent for the exceptions
cards.text: Unclear errors, failed fixes and errors with one cause get judgement.

cards.title: One confirm tool
cards.text: Commit check, replay and tests in one call.

cards.title: Measured against today
cards.text: The triage suite: decisions right at least as often, at a lower cost per error.
